description: This file defines a database migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 4.3.1. It includes logic to drop an existing table 'ohrm_reset_password' if present and to create a new 'ohrm_reset_password' table with columns for ID, reset email, request date, and reset code.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class responsible for updating the database schema to version 4.3.1 for OrangeHRM. It creates the 'ohrm_reset_password' table with relevant columns and primary key.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration by checking if the 'ohrm_reset_password' table exists, drops it if present, and then creates a new version of the table with specific columns.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number '4.3.1' associated with this migration.
